context_design: same model, separate agent context; not an independent human reader
query_execution: three immutable English queries, in input order, exactly once each; no domain or recency filters; system2_search_query; response_length long
rank_reconstruction: first-response displayed block order preserved. Engine-native ranks were not separately exposed; refID numeric suffixes were not treated as rank.
minimum_count_caveat: read-count only, not relevant-hit or verified-fit count
search_provenance: runs include tool_query audit URI and exact payload; no HTML engine URL synthesized
primary_policy: only original research/patent content used for technical observations; patent mirrors treated as reproductions. Secondary background quotations were not used as C1/C2 support.

automatic_exposure.treatment: auto-returned snippets excluded from trial and not opened
